title: MagicLootStructures
description: Add any items to vanilla loot
body:
A very simple plugin, created as an addon for [MagicStructures](https://modrinth.com/plugin/magicstructure). But it can be used anywhere.
Add loot to any loottable with a single command.

**Commands:**
```
mls add <loottable> <chance 1..100> <min amount> <max amount> <id_item>
```

```
mls remove <id_item>
```

**Permission:**

```
mls.admin - Gives the ability to use all commands
```
